nodes.description: Registry reference stored in LendingPool used to resolve core, dataProvider, parametersProvider and feeProvider.
Reference to the LendingPoolCore contract that holds all funds and reserve state.
Reference to LendingPoolDataProvider used for health factor and collateral computations.
Reference to the fee provider used to compute loan origination fees.
Trusted lending pool address; enforced by onlyLendingPool modifier on sensitive core functions.
Mapping of reserve address to ReserveData holding liquidity indexes, rates and configuration.
Underlying asset of the interest bearing token, used for balance and index lookups.
Per-user normalized income index used to compute accrued aToken balances.
Mutex counter guarding nonReentrant functions against reentrant calls.
Constant bounding the stable rate borrow size as a percentage of available liquidity.
External payable entry point that mints aTokens and moves the underlying asset into the core.
External function called by the aToken to burn tokens and transfer underlying back to the user.
External borrow entry point performing collateral, health factor and liquidity checks then transferring funds.
External payable repay entry point updating borrow state and routing fees and principal.
External function switching a user borrow between stable and variable rate modes.
Public function rebalancing a user stable rate against market conditions without caller restriction.
External function toggling whether a deposit is used as collateral, guarded by balance decrease checks.
External payable liquidation entry point that delegatecalls into the liquidation manager.
External function lending liquidity to a receiver contract that must return amount plus fee.
Initializer wiring the addressesProvider derived dependencies, protected by the initializer modifier.
Core state transition for borrows, updating reserve indexes, user balances and interest rates.
Core function transferring ERC20 or native ETH to a user via low level call.
Core function compounding the flashloan fee into the liquidity index and refreshing rates.
Internal function creating or upgrading an InitializableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy for a protocol component.
External redeem function cumulating balance, burning aTokens and calling the pool for underlying.
Internal function minting accrued interest and refreshing the user index.
Caller controlled address used for authorization checks and balance ownership.
Block timestamp used in interest accrual and stored as lastUpdateTimestamp.
Delegatecall into the configurable liquidation manager address inside liquidationCall.
Low level call.value transferring ETH to a user controlled address with fixed gas.
Inline assembly sstore writing the implementation or admin slot of the proxy.
External call to the user supplied flashloan receiver before balance verification.
Subtraction of payback or liquidated amounts from principal and fee balances.
Reserve address parameter used by deposit, redeemUnderlying, borrow, repay and flashLoan.
Amount parameter for deposit, redeemUnderlying, borrow, repay and flashLoan actions.
Interest rate mode selector parameter of the borrow function.
Referral code parameter emitted in deposit and borrow events.
Target user for whom a repayment is executed in the repay function.
Flashloan receiver contract address supplied by the caller.
Arbitrary bytes forwarded to the flashloan receiver executeOperation call.
Borrower address being liquidated in liquidationCall.
Collateral reserve address being liquidated.
Amount of principal the liquidator wants to repay.
Flag selecting whether the liquidator receives aTokens or the underlying asset.
Core balance snapshot taken before the flashloan transfer.
Core balance snapshot taken after the flashloan receiver callback.
Total flashloan fee computed from basis points.
Protocol share of the flashloan fee computed from basis points.
Boolean result of the delegatecall in liquidationCall.

edges.reason: deposit uses msg.sender as the depositing account and aToken owner.
borrow performs collateral and health factor checks on msg.sender.
repay uses msg.sender as repayer and restricts whole-loan repayment on behalf of others.
setUserUseReserveAsCollateral checks and updates collateral flag for msg.sender.
liquidationCall receives msg.sender as the liquidator credited with the collateral.
onlyLendingPool compares msg.sender with the stored lendingPoolAddress of the core.
updateStateOnBorrow stores uint40(block.timestamp) as the user lastUpdateTimestamp.
updateStateOnFlashLoan refreshes reserve rates stamped with block.timestamp.
cumulateBalanceInternal derives accrued interest from time based reserve indexes.
borrow reads liquidity and reserve configuration from the core contract.
deposit calls core.updateStateOnDeposit and core.transferToReserve.
borrow uses dataProvider.calculateUserGlobalData and calculateCollateralNeededInETH.
borrow uses feeProvider to compute the loan origination fee.
borrow caps the stable rate borrow size using parametersProvider.getMaxStableRateBorrowSizePercent.
liquidationCall delegatecalls into an externally configured liquidation manager address.
flashLoan transfers funds then calls receiver.executeOperation before verifying repayment.
transferToUser sends ETH through a low level call.value to a user controlled address.
updateImplInternal creates or upgrades proxies whose slots are written via inline assembly.
repay drives subtraction of payback amounts and origination fees from user balances.
updateStateOnBorrow path performs balance and fee additions feeding later subtractions.
deposit uses _reserve to resolve the aToken and the reserve state.
redeemUnderlying validates liquidity and transfers assets for _reserve.
borrow checks active, unfreezed and available liquidity for _reserve.
repay updates reserve state for _reserve.
flashLoan uses _reserve to measure liquidity before and after the callback.
deposit mints aTokens and transfers _amount into the reserve.
redeemUnderlying checks available liquidity against _amount.
borrow validates _amount against liquidity and stable rate limits.
flashLoan uses _amount to compute fees and perform the transfer.
borrow casts and validates _interestRateMode before updating state.
borrow emits _referralCode in the Borrow event.
repay resolves borrow balances, fees and state updates for _onBehalfOf.
flashLoan casts _receiver to IFlashLoanReceiver and transfers funds to it.
flashLoan forwards _params to the receiver executeOperation call.
liquidationCall encodes _user into the delegatecall payload for the liquidation manager.
liquidationCall encodes _collateral into the delegatecall payload.
liquidationCall encodes _purchaseAmount into the delegatecall payload.
liquidationCall encodes _receiveAToken into the delegatecall payload.
flashLoan records local_availableLiquidityBefore prior to transferring funds.
flashLoan compares local_availableLiquidityAfter with the expected balance plus fee.
flashLoan computes local_amountFee from the total fee basis points.
flashLoan computes local_protocolFee as the protocol share of the fee.
liquidationCall asserts local_success returned by the delegatecall.
AToken.redeem calls the lending pool redeemUnderlying path which reads core balances.
AToken.redeem relies on cumulated balances and index arithmetic before burning.

normalization_plan.reason: _reserve is a per-call address parameter consumed by the deposit entry point.
_amount is a per-call quantity parameter consumed by the deposit entry point.
_interestRateMode only qualifies the borrow state transition.
_referralCode is only emitted by the borrow event.
_onBehalfOf identifies the borrower whose debt the repay call settles.
_receiver is the target of the flashLoan external call.
_params is forwarded verbatim to the receiver executeOperation call.
_user is the borrower passed into the liquidation delegatecall.
_collateral selects the reserve seized during liquidation.
_purchaseAmount bounds the principal repaid during liquidation.
_receiveAToken chooses the payout mode of the liquidation.
local snapshot of core liquidity taken inside flashLoan.
local snapshot used by flashLoan to verify repayment consistency.
local fee value computed and consumed only in flashLoan.
local protocol fee value consumed only in flashLoan.
local_success is the direct return value of the liquidation delegatecall.
